latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of emoji-reaction-automator.

- Suggests emoji reactions for text messages based on detected sentiment (positive, negative, funny, curious, excited, neutral).
- Provides a simple API for integrating emoji suggestions into messaging platforms.
- Uses lightweight, rule-based sentiment mapping for fast performance and ease of use.
- Supports a wide range of emoji categories to enhance conversation engagement.
